who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane SC under rebuild-1115
what: D116's equality harness ran a drawn crate alone (its dependency and prelude unsolved) and compared the tables against written scopes the run had left unknown: `use crate::z as p` was 'old Absent' only because the core could not decide `p`'s value namespace through a glob of the extern `m1`. The command (cells/switch.rs) refuses such a scope (`Unwritten::Unknown`) before the same check; the library path skipped that refusal. Under it sat two more disagreements the drawn test never reached: a macro_rules! redefined after a child's `mod` line (the Textual table kept the last definition alone, `TextualCut`), and a plain first segment found in a call's output (R6, an outer extern crate taken first) that the tables walked as decided.
cost: about an hour; the runner cuts long panic lines, so a drawn world had to be printed one compact line per module to be read
cause: the refusal of unknown scopes lived in the command's driver, not in the check it guards
whys: two drivers of one check; the check trusted its caller to hand it decided scopes; the drawn test called the weaker driver
class: a check whose precondition is enforced by one caller and not by the check itself
prevention: done: `Cells::links_agree` refuses a scope with unknowns itself (`Disagreement::Unknown`); the drawn test solves dependencies first (`cells::links_agree_world`); cut rows in the Textual table; first segments from a call or glob are `Unfollowed::Prelude`. Also: this lane edited one test file with a python script (rule 72 says edit tools only); not repeated
